images.prompt:
Generate exactly ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration, ideally 1536x864. Use case: illustration-story. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background, minimalist black hand-drawn thin slightly wobbly pen outlines, generous white space (at least 40%), subject around 50-60% of image. Flat restrained red, orange, blue accents. Clean absurd product sketch drawn by a serious engineer. No shading, gradients, paper texture, noise, commercial vector illustration, realistic UI, formal flowchart, PPT, title, heading, border around the whole image, watermark, childish cuteness.
Required protagonist XiaoM 小M: small mushroom worker with rounded RED dome cap, 3-5 WHITE polka dots, CREAM stem body, BLACK hand-drawn contours, two tiny BLACK dot eyes on cream stem, thin limbs, deadpan serious expression. Red dotted cap + pale body, never solid-black body. One or two thin ORANGE mycelium threads carry the actual information involved in the scene, not decorative roots. XiaoM performs the core action. Readable sparse handwritten Chinese labels only as specified. No extra explanatory text. Invent a fresh low-tech physical metaphor; no conveyor, fish, generic architecture boxes, control lever, toolbox stamping or mascot in corner. Single unpartitioned scene, not a composite or multi-panel image.
Theme: an agent reads and edits REAL objects on a shared whiteboard, rather than merely chatting.
Scene: a floating, slightly irregular whiteboard at center-right, three individually outlined physical paper cards on its surface, one connected line between two cards. A serious XiaoM straddles the lower rim of this board as an actual repair worker. With one hand it lifts a corner of a real board card to read its small identity tag "ID 07"; with the other it uses a pen to directly revise the SAME card's line of writing. One orange mycelium filament runs from its hand to the specific card, tracing a read-and-write loop with two very subtle arrowheads. The visible board object is tangible and changed by its action. A tiny blue label "读写对象" beside the hand, and "同一画布" by the lower board edge. No chat bubbles at all, no chat window, no human. Main meaning is direct manipulation of an identified object, not text conversation. Leave broad empty white margins and upper-left region empty. Text ONLY "ID 07", "读写对象", "同一画布".

processing.resize: aspect-preserving white padding if needed; no content cropped
processing.palette_white_point: Near-white palette entries (all RGB >=248) encoded as pure white during PNG compression; originals preserved
